NET_SALES.rule: Watch when −3% to 0% vs budget; Off track below −3%.
NET_SALES.what: The money customers actually paid us in the picked period, after returns, discounts and VAT.
NET_SALES.why: It is the top line every other number divides by or adds up to; if it slips, the margin and stock numbers follow.
NET_SALES.formula: Gross sales at ticket price − markdowns and discounts − returns, excluding VAT.

TOTAL_MARGIN.rule: Watch when −1.0 pp to 0 vs budget; Off track below −1.0 pp. Provisional until the monthly true-up.
TOTAL_MARGIN.what: The share of each euro of sales we keep after paying suppliers for the goods, counting the money suppliers pay back to us.
TOTAL_MARGIN.why: Front margin alone hides half of a reseller’s profit; this is the margin the business really keeps.
TOTAL_MARGIN.formula: (Front margin + back margin) ÷ Net sales. Front = sales − cost of goods; back = supplier rebates, promo funding and listing fees.

WEEKS_OF_COVER.rule: On track within ±1 wk of target 9.5; Watch 1–2 wks away; Off track beyond ±2 wks.
WEEKS_OF_COVER.what: How many weeks our stock would last at the sales we expect, if nothing more arrived.
WEEKS_OF_COVER.why: Too little and shelves go empty; too much and the stock ends in markdown. It decides the next buying actions.
WEEKS_OF_COVER.formula: (Stock on hand + stock on order, at cost) ÷ forecast cost of goods sold per week.

MARKDOWN.rule: Lower is better. Watch when 0 to +1.0 pp vs budget; Off track above +1.0 pp.
MARKDOWN.what: The part of the ticket price we gave away through price cuts and promotions.
MARKDOWN.why: Every point of markdown is margin lost; rising markdown is the first sign of too much or the wrong stock.
MARKDOWN.formula: Markdown value (permanent + promotional) ÷ gross sales at ticket price.

AVAILABILITY.rule: On track at 97% or above; Watch 95–97%; Off track below 95%.
AVAILABILITY.what: How often our best-selling products were actually on the shelf when a customer could buy them.
AVAILABILITY.why: A gap on the shelf is a sale that never happens; it is the "too little stock" failure mode.
AVAILABILITY.formula: SKU-store-days in stock ÷ SKU-store-days ranged, for the top-500 sellers, weighted by sales.
drill: On hand, on order, in transit, last sale.

EBITDA.rule: Watch when −5% to 0 vs budget; Off track below −5%. Provisional until month-end close.
EBITDA.what: Profit before interest, tax and depreciation in the picked period (at Week: the month so far): what is left after all operating costs.
EBITDA.why: It is the bottom line the board sees; every margin and cost move lands here.
EBITDA.formula: Total margin − shrink − store costs − central costs − fulfilment costs; ÷ Net sales for the margin %.
drill: Total margin → shrink → store OpEx → central OpEx → fulfilment → EBITDA.

LFL_GROWTH.rule: Watch when −2 pp to 0 vs budget LFL; Off track below −2 pp.
LFL_GROWTH.what: Sales growth in the stores that were open a year ago too, so new openings and closures do not distort it.
LFL_GROWTH.why: It tells you whether the existing business is growing, not just the estate.
LFL_GROWTH.formula: Sales of stores open ≥ 13 months in the picked period ÷ the same stores’ sales in the same retail weeks last year − 1.

FRONT_GM.rule: Watch when −1.0 pp to 0 vs budget; Off track below −1.0 pp.
FRONT_GM.what: The share of sales left after paying what the goods cost us, landed in our warehouse.
FRONT_GM.why: It is the price-minus-cost half of profit; pricing, buying cost and category mix show up here first.
FRONT_GM.formula: (Net sales − cost of goods at landed cost) ÷ Net sales.
drill: Dumbbell: plan vs actual per category.

SELL_THROUGH.rule: Watch when −5 pp to 0 vs the season target; Off track below −5 pp.
SELL_THROUGH.what: The share of the season’s stock we have sold so far.
SELL_THROUGH.why: It says whether the season is clearing on time or heading for clearance markdown.
SELL_THROUGH.formula: Units sold season to date ÷ (opening stock units + units received).
drill: Curve vs target curve per category.

GMROI.rule: On track at 2.5× or above; Watch 2.0–2.5×; Off track below 2.0×.
GMROI.what: How many euros of margin each euro tied up in stock earned over the last 12 months.
GMROI.why: Stock costs money to hold; this says whether it is earning its keep.
GMROI.formula: Front gross margin for the last 52 weeks ÷ average stock at cost over the same 52 week-ends.
drill: Stock at cost by category vs cover

SUPPLIER_OTIF.rule: On track at 95% or above; Watch 92–95%; Off track below 92%.
SUPPLIER_OTIF.what: The share of purchase-order lines suppliers delivered on the agreed day and in the agreed quantity.
SUPPLIER_OTIF.why: Late or short deliveries become empty shelves two weeks later.
SUPPLIER_OTIF.formula: PO lines received on time and in full ÷ PO lines due.
drill: Spend, OTIF, lead time, PPV, back margin %.

CHANNEL_MIX.rule: On track within ±2 pp of the plan mix per channel; Watch 2–3 pp away; Off track beyond 3 pp.
CHANNEL_MIX.what: What share of sales came through stores, online and wholesale.
CHANNEL_MIX.why: A shift between channels changes margin and cost to serve even when total sales look fine.
CHANNEL_MIX.formula: Each channel’s net sales ÷ total net sales, compared with the planned mix.
